image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a custom alloy car wheel mounted on a red vehicle. The wheel features a five-spoke star design with a polished silver/chrome finish and a deep-dish lip. A black rubber tire is mounted on the rim, displaying white lettering ('COOPER COBRA') on the sidewall. Behind the spokes, a brake disc and caliper assembly are visible. The background includes the red fender of the car and asphalt ground.

artifact_observations.location: Inner barrel of the wheel rim (behind the spokes)
artifact_observations.reasoning: There is faint, illegible text or pattern etched into the inner lip of the wheel barrel. While some custom wheels have branding here, the characters appear slightly warped and nonsensical, typical of AI struggling with small, curved text surfaces.

artifact_observations.location: Brake caliper and rotor behind the spokes
artifact_observations.reasoning: The mechanical components behind the spokes lack sharp definition. The brake rotor holes appear slightly irregular in spacing and shape, and the caliper blends somewhat into the background without clear mounting hardware, suggesting minor structural ambiguity.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of wheel (alloy vs steel) and verify it matches the 'car wheel' class label with high confidence.
To ensure the boundary between the rubber tire and metal rim is sharp and continuous, checking for any bleeding or fusion artifacts.
To verify the depth relationship between the front face of the spokes and the brake components behind them, ensuring no geometric melting occurs in the recessed areas.
To rigorously audit the 'COOPER COBRA' lettering for character correctness and kerning, as this is a high-risk area for AI generation.

focus_areas: Legibility and geometry of tire sidewall text
Structural integrity and symmetry of the 5-spoke alloy design
Clarity and physical plausibility of brake components behind spokes
Sharpness of the boundary between tire rubber and metal rim
